integrity: The formulae and infinite proof were reconstructed from prime-factor identities, Dirichlet's theorem and the prime number theorem. Finite exact arithmetic is corroboration, not proof of infinitude. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification holds only for \(n=2^a3^b\) with integers \(a,b\ge2\), not for boundary exponents or arbitrary integers. The asymptotic uses total exponent height rather than ordinary magnitude. A differently formulated prior proof is a possible literature risk.
title: Prime-indexed commutation of the arithmetic derivative and Euler totient on two-prime powers
